facts.quote: Table 1: Main results. All numbers are measured by us: AutomationBench harness 1.0.6, api toolset, 50 steps, one rollout per task, 600 tasks (6 domains × \times 100); MCP-Mark, 127 tasks over five MCP servers; BFCL v4, all seven official categories plus the official weighted average.
facts.note: AutomationBench harness 1.0.6, api toolset, 50 steps, one rollout per task, 600 tasks (6 domains x 100); MCP-Mark 127 tasks over five MCP servers; BFCL v4 all seven official categories plus the weighted average; MCP-Mark and BFCL v4 cells are means of four evaluations per model, whose standard deviations are in Table 5 . Our rows’ AutomationBench cells are means of one to four evaluations (Table 4 ), the baselines’ single evaluations.
